---
title: inspect_ranges.attackbox
description: "The attack-box extension point: implement and register an external provider for INSPECT_RANGES_ATTACK_BOX."
reference: inspect_ranges.attackbox
---

The attack-box extension point: an `AttackBoxFactory` named by `INSPECT_RANGES_ATTACK_BOX=<module>.<factory>[:<config>]` returns an `AttackBoxBackend` bundle, and the foothold attachment and resolution machinery it builds on are public here. The provider boots a range's dedicated attack box from a `FootholdAttachment` and returns an `AttackBoxHandle` whose `exec_endpoint` serves the daemon wire protocol.

See [Registering a Provider](../attackbox.qmd#registering-a-provider) for the grammar and the registration walkthrough, and [Provider Contract](../attackbox.qmd#provider-contract) for the proof obligations an implementation is held to.
